##Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
```

##Load Data
```{r}
insects <- read_csv2("data/insect_raw/Data_Uhler_2021_main.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
```

##Check Data Structure
```{r}
insects %>%
  glimpse()
```

##Clean Data - Arlette
```{r}
#clean possible hidden NAs from character variables
insects <- insects %>%
  replace_with_na_all(condition = ~.x %in% c(common_na_strings))
```

```{r}
#check numeric variables for hidden NAs
insects %>%
  select(-c(plotid,
             quadrant_id,
             landscape_type,
             landscape_type_2,
             plot_type,
             plot_type_2,
             landscape_plot,
             date_start,
             date_end)) %>%
  summary()

#Per insect_README.txt, values of 0 seen here are not NAs.
#No hidden NAs.
```

```{r}
#view NA summary
insects %>%
  miss_var_summary
```
